en.title: I
en.summary: The letter I is the ninth letter of the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: The letter name
paragraphs: The letter name is the sound /i/ or /j/. Its main sound is the vowel sound /i/, as in the word (inimă) /iˈnel/, which means ring. This letter has three different sounds in total.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Spread your lips wide and raise the front of your tongue close to your roof. Let your vocal cords vibrate, and feel the buzz by touching your neck. For the second sound, glide your tongue quickly toward the roof while moving into another vowel. For the third sound, raise your tongue slightly without making a full vowel, releasing a brief breath.

sections.title: Where each sound occurs
paragraphs: As a standard full vowel, this letter sounds like the sound /i/, as in (inel) /iˈnel/. It sounds like the glide sound /j/ next to another vowel, as in (iarbă) /ˈjar.bə/. At the end of a word after consonants, it marks a short whisper sound /ʲ/, heard in (lupi) /lupʲ/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not replace the vowel with the short vowel in English bit. Keep your tongue high and tense, like the vowel in see. At the end of words, do not add an extra syllable. Never turn the final light mark into a full vowel sound.
